name: Solar Home Oklahoma Electric
old_description: Solar Home Oklahoma Electric provides custom residential and commercial installation solutions designed to power your life and business with sustainable energy. By combining localized incentives to maximize your upfront savings with proactive maintenance programs that ensure long-term, cost-effective performance, we make the transition to solar both seamless and worry-free. Experience the peace of mind that comes with local expertise and a system built to run problem-free for years to come.
about:
Solar Home Oklahoma Electric operates from Moore, Oklahoma, serving residential and commercial customers across the state with solar energy installations and ongoing support. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders in the available materials.

The firm designs and installs custom photovoltaic systems for homes and businesses, offering three panel technologies — monocrystalline, polycrystalline, and thin-film — sized and configured to each roof. Its service portfolio includes SunSync installation, EcoCare maintenance with routine checkups, PowerPlay real-time production monitoring, SunGuard weather-resistant panel options, SolarFinancing flexible payment plans, and ShineOn personalized consultations. A construction manager, Kyle Isbel, oversees project execution.

Customers range from individual homeowners seeking lower utility bills to commercial property owners pursuing sustainability goals. The company emphasizes Oklahoma-specific incentive navigation and promotes energy independence for both sectors. Testimonials reference installations in Oklahoma, though the marketing copy also mentions clients in Miami and New York.

Solar Home Oklahoma Electric positions its differentiation on localized incentive expertise, proactive maintenance programs, transparent pricing, and a single-point-of-contact experience from consultation through long-term monitoring. The company states its systems are built to run problem-free for years with dedicated local support.
